title: This app is INSANE!
body: This app has boosted my creativity significantly. before i used to shift into my own thoughts instead of work and now i am like a writing machine with my screenplays! I highly recommend, even though the subscription is kinda expensive but man. it’s so worth it!!
author: jarpenet

title: Crashes on startup
body: The app now crashes every time I try to start playback. The previous version didn't crash.
author: -1j

title: Incredible
body: This app is great. It helps me sleep, focus and relax. I love sleeping when hearing rain. This app gives it all.
author: fkgjx

title: Solid app
body: I’ve been using Brain.fm on/off for a few years. While the core service has always been great, now the app is also intuitive and works well.
author: MikkoRe

title: Great when chooses to work
body: Bought a month of subscription and the app doesn’t stream me anything anymore. Instead it keeps “buffering” for eternity, regardless of a perfect signal and other data flowing freely. Frustrating.
author: youkahainen

title: Mindset
body: I have been using this app occasionally for a year. For me it truly quickens time needed to set me on the right mindset, whether it’s about reading (focus), meditation, quick relaxation or sleeping. Also the selection of tunes makes it suitable to all preferences of sound. Highly recommended.
author: solid info
